description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class named ShippingConfigsController that manages shipping configuration related web endpoints in an e-commerce platform. It handles displaying and saving shipping configurations, as well as managing shipping country support, and integrates with services for shipping and country data.

classes.name: ShippingConfigsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for managing shipping configurations, including display, save, and country support management.

methods.name: displayShippingConfigs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show current shipping configurations for the admin interface.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updates to the shipping configuration.

methods.name: pageCountries
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginating and searching countries supported for shipping.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update whether a country is supported for shipping.
